Oh ja, ja, das hast du gut gemacht, mein Freund!

Na und? Es ist doch gut, oder? May it serve you in good health, mein Freund.

Good, good. You could be bloody damn good... If you don't get killed first.
Well? Good, eh? Let it sit for a while and you'll get it in your blood, you'll see.

Well, I'll be... Maybe you've got something in you! Keep it up, my friend!
Na und? Es ist doch gut, oder? May it serve you in good health, mein Freund.
Oh ja, ja, das hast du gut gemacht, mein Freund!
Aye, I think you understood it right. And now I hope it'll come in useful to you.
Hmm... Alright then, you're good, keep at it!
